title: Fail-closed pre-push review with a round budget
summary: The pre-push review stops being advisory. `--warn-only` is deleted, so `osf review run` now exits non-zero on a kept must-fix or should-fix finding and on a review that could not run, and a new round budget kept in the journal state (outside the worktree) lets a push through after three failed rounds while a could-not-run streak ends blocked with a message. A credential preflight decides a reviewer with no key and no login file before any worker starts, the work item can arrive through `OSF_WORK_ITEM` instead of a file, login-file secrets join the redaction set, and the whole-run timeout drops to 1800s with the moon task and `osf.toml` updated to match.

nodes.label: moon `review` task
nodes.subtitle: osf review run --if-enabled --work-item .osf/out/work-item.txt
nodes.summary: The pre-push task. It loses `--warn-only` and gains `--work-item`, so its exit code now gates the push.

nodes.label: Builder agent
nodes.subtitle: develop job, has a shell
nodes.summary: Runs the review before pushing and fixes what it reports. Its own workspace can change the result, which is why this gates the push and not the merge.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: review_run_exit_code
nodes.summary: Loses the `--warn-only` override and now always returns the real code: 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 could-not-run.

nodes.label: finish_review
nodes.subtitle: verdict + kept findings + round budget
nodes.summary: Computes the base exit code from the reducer verdict, promotes a Pass to 1 when a kept must-fix or should-fix finding exists, then applies the round budget when `count_rounds` is set. `review reduce` calls it with counting off.

nodes.label: review_config
nodes.subtitle: in_sandbox_rounds, could_not_run_rounds
nodes.summary: Two new `[review]` fields, both defaulting to 3 and both rejected at 0. The whole-run timeout default drops from 2700 to 1800 seconds.

nodes.label: osf.toml [review]
nodes.subtitle: concurrency 16, total_timeout 1800
nodes.summary: The repository's own review settings, sized for thirteen lenses and two reviewers inside the thirty-minute limit. The opencode secret name is corrected in the comment.

nodes.label: review_run::run
nodes.subtitle: setup, preflight, workers, reduce
nodes.summary: The orchestration module. It gains the round-count store, the credential preflight and the preflight-only reviewer run.

nodes.label: round_allows_push
nodes.subtitle: RoundKind -> bool
nodes.summary: A pass clears the counts. A findings round increments and allows the push once past the limit. A could-not-run round increments and returns an error past its own limit, so a missing credential can never be laundered into a pass.

nodes.label: RoundCounts
nodes.subtitle: journal state/review-rounds/<hash>.json
nodes.summary: Two counters keyed by the canonical worktree path, stored under the journal state directory so the builder cannot edit them.

nodes.label: missing_credentials
nodes.subtitle: Reviewer::missing_credentials
nodes.summary: Decides before any process starts whether a reviewer has no way to sign in: no non-empty credential variable and no existing login path under the real home. A templated reviewer is exempt because its template may carry its own auth.

nodes.label: preflight_and_not_run
nodes.subtitle: skip reason vs credential reason
nodes.summary: Orders the reasons a reviewer sits out: family error, then skip reason, then the credential preflight. A reviewer with no read-only mode is left to its worker, not judged by the preflight.

nodes.label: Reviewer worker
nodes.subtitle: agent process per lens
nodes.summary: The agent process that answers each lens. It no longer starts at all when the preflight has already decided the reviewer cannot run.

nodes.label: Reducer
nodes.subtitle: Verdict::Pass | Fail | CouldNotRun
nodes.summary: Produces the verdict and the kept findings. Its verdict still decides the class of round; the kept findings decide whether a Pass is really a fail.

nodes.label: read_work_item
nodes.subtitle: file, then OSF_WORK_ITEM
nodes.summary: Falls back to the `OSF_WORK_ITEM` environment variable when no path is given or the path cannot be read, so the pre-push hook never has to write a file.

nodes.label: secret_values::held
nodes.subtitle: env vars + login-file leaves
nodes.summary: Now also collects every string leaf of the agents' JSON login files, so a provider key kept in opencode's auth file is redacted like an environment variable.

nodes.label: changeset_risk::changed_files
nodes.subtitle: ignores untracked .osf/
nodes.summary: Filters osf's own untracked output out of the changed-file set, so one review round cannot change which lenses the next round selects.

edges.label: --if-enabled --work-item
edges.summary: The task now passes the work item path and no longer passes `--warn-only`, so the command's exit code reaches the push.
The builder's push now runs through a task that can refuse it.

edges.label: count_rounds = true
edges.summary: `review run` counts rounds; `review reduce` calls the same function with counting off.
The one place a failing review can be turned into an allowed push, and only after the configured number of rounds.
